verdict.rationale: Munito's own docs list vision and speech-to-text as platform capabilities, with an OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text API and an audio transcription guide. Document extraction is also offered beside chat, and the docs probe confirms speech to text on the same API platform. Missing for 10: any image-generation endpoint, text-to-speech or other audio output, detailed vision usage docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
